title: Form 1099-S: who files the information return on a real estate sale
rule: The real estate reporting person files Form 1099-S on a reportable real estate sale or exchange and gives the seller a statement; corporate and other exempt sellers are excepted. A written agreement made at or before closing, signed by an eligible designee, designates the filer. Otherwise it is the person responsible for closing: the settlement agent listed on a RESPA settlement form such as a Closing Disclosure; else whoever prepares a closing statement given to both parties; with none or several, the buyer's qualifying attorney, the seller's, then the main disbursing title or escrow company. Failing these: mortgage lender, seller's broker, buyer's broker, then buyer. No separate filing charge.
changeWatch: Amendments to 26 CFR 1.6045-4(e) (who reports, the attorney and title-company order, which persons may be designated) or to section 6045(e), and each new revision of the Form 1099-S instructions, including how they map the regulation's Uniform Settlement Statement onto the Closing Disclosure.

sources.quote: the person who prepares a closing statement presented to the transferor and transferee at, or in connection with, the closing of the real estate transaction
